draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Koregaon Park! Once known as Koregaon Road Estate, it's a green residential pocket that people now call Pune's Restaurant Suburb, playing the role Bandra plays for Mumbai.
draft.hungryLine: You're in the right place to eat, North Main Road alone has more than 50 restaurants doing everything from Italian and Thai to local Indian food.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Bund Garden and the old Fitzgerald Bridge are both under 20 minutes on foot, and the Pune Tribal Museum is about 18 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Walk to Bund Garden by the Mula river, it's named after the bandh, or dam, right there.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The National War Memorial Southern Command nearby is the only war memorial in South Asia built with contributions from citizens.

spots.name: Fitzgerald Bridge
spots.detail: 19 min walk · Pune's first spandrel arch bridge, from 1867, with a Medici lion at each end

status.text: Closed to cars, open to walkers

spots.name: Bund Garden
spots.detail: 18 min walk · A riverside garden next to Fitzgerald Bridge

spots.name: Pune Tribal Museum
spots.detail: 18 min walk · Displays on the culture of Maharashtra's tribes

tips.title: Come hungry in the evening.
tips.body: Most Pune restaurants keep similar hours, and the bars here in Koregaon Park stay open till at least midnight.

tips.title: Go to ABC Farms if you can't decide.
tips.body: It has many restaurants in one place, so everyone in your group finds something.

story.title: A bridge over the Mula-Mutha
story.body: Captain Robert S. Sellon of the Royal Engineers built the Fitzgerald Bridge, named for the then Governor of Bombay. It linked Bund Garden to the Chima garden.

story.title: Rowing on the river
story.body: The Royal Connaught Boat Club was founded just upstream, with a boathouse and slipway on the Mula-Mutha. It sits just below where the Mula and Mutha rivers meet.

story.title: Gandhi at the Aga Khan Palace
story.body: In nearby Kalyani Nagar, Mahatma Gandhi was imprisoned at the Aga Khan Palace. His wife Kasturba Gandhi died there.

story.title: Museums and memorials
story.body: The Pune Tribal Museum was set up in 1962 and opened its displays in 1965. In 1998 the National War Memorial Southern Command was unveiled, with a Kargil-era MiG-23BN on show.

story.title: Restaurant Suburb
story.body: Koregaon Park is turning from leafy homes into a dining and nightlife hub, with art galleries and live music bars. The Pune Metro Aqua Line reached Bund Garden in 2024.

food.name: ABC Farms
food.detail: Lots of restaurants in one spot, good when the group can't agree
